name: loadVideo
signature: loadVideo(QString filename, QString id, float x, float y, bool show, float alpha)
description: Loads a video file from disk and associates it with a unique identifier. Supported formats depend on the system's multimedia backend and installed codecs (MP4, WMV, MOV, AVI, etc.).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Path to the video file (absolute path recommended)

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X-coordinate (pixels) from left edge of screen (absolute) or relative if <1)

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y-coordinate (pixels) from top edge of screen (absolute) or relative if <1)

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: If true, starts playing immediately; if false, loads but does not play

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. Video format support depends on platform codecs.

name: playVideo
description: Plays a previously loaded video. Can optionally keep the last frame visible after playback ends.

parameters.name: keepVisibleAtEnd
parameters.description: If true, pauses at last frame instead of hiding the video window

name: playVideoPopout
signature: playVideoPopout(QString id, float fromX, float fromY, float atCenterX, float atCenterY, float finalSizeX, float finalSizeY, float popupDuration, bool frozenInTransition)
description: Plays a video with a popout effect (grows from a point, expands to full size, then shrinks back). Useful for interactive presentations and guided tours.

parameters.name: fromX
parameters.description: Start X position (absolute or relative if <1)

parameters.name: fromY
parameters.description: Start Y position (absolute or relative if <1)

parameters.name: atCenterX
parameters.description: Target center X position (absolute or relative if <1)

parameters.name: atCenterY
parameters.description: Target center Y position (absolute or relative if <1)

parameters.name: finalSizeX
parameters.description: Final width (-1 for auto from aspect ratio, >1 absolute pixels, [0-1] relative to screen)

parameters.name: finalSizeY
parameters.description: Final height (-1 for auto from aspect ratio, >1 absolute pixels, [0-1] relative to screen)

parameters.name: popupDuration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds for the grow/shrink animation

parameters.name: frozenInTransition
parameters.description: If true, video pauses during transition; if false, plays while animating

name: pauseVideo
description: Pauses video playback. The video remains visible on screen and can be resumed with playVideo().

name: stopVideo
description: Stops video playback completely and hides the video window. The video will restart from the beginning when played again.

name: dropVideo
description: Unloads a video from memory and releases all associated resources. The video can no longer be played unless loaded again.
example:
// Unload video to free memory
StelVideoMgr.dropVideo("intro");

name: seekVideo
signature: seekVideo(QString id, qint64 milliseconds, bool pause)
description: Jumps to a specific position in the video. Can optionally pause after seeking. Useful for skipping to key scenes.

parameters.name: pause
parameters.description: If true, pauses after seeking; if false, continues playing

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. May not work with all codecs.

name: setVideoXY
signature: setVideoXY(QString id, float x, float y, bool relative)
description: Moves the video to a new position on screen. Can use absolute pixel coordinates or relative offsets.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X position or offset (absolute or relative if <1)

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y position or offset (absolute or relative if <1)

parameters.name: relative
parameters.description: If true, adds to current position; if false, sets absolute position

name: setVideoAlpha
description: Sets the opacity (transparency) of the video. 0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque.

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. Qt6 supports semi-transparency well; Qt5 may only support fully transparent/opaque.

name: resizeVideo
signature: resizeVideo(QString id, float width, float height)
description: Changes the size of the video frame. Supports absolute pixels, relative to screen, or auto-scaling based on aspect ratio.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width (-1 = auto from aspect ratio, >1 = pixels, 0-1 = relative to screen)

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height (-1 = auto from aspect ratio, >1 = pixels, 0-1 = relative to screen)

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. Auto-scaling preserves aspect ratio.

name: showVideo
description: Shows or hides the video window without unloading it. Hidden videos are still loaded and can be shown again instantly.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show, false to hide

name: getVideoDuration
description: Returns the total duration of the video in milliseconds. May return -1 if the video has not been fully loaded yet.
returnDescription: Duration in milliseconds, or -1 on error

name: getVideoPosition
description: Returns the current playback position of the video in milliseconds.
returnDescription: Current position in milliseconds, or -1 on error
example:
var pos = StelVideoMgr.getVideoPosition("intro");
core.debug("Current position: " + (pos/1000).toFixed(1) + " seconds");

name: getVideoResolution
description: Returns the native resolution of the video in pixels. May return an invalid size if the video has not been fully loaded.
returnDescription: Video resolution as QSize (width, height), or invalid size on error

name: getVideoWidth
description: Returns the native width of the video in pixels. Returns -1 if the video has not been fully loaded.
returnDescription: Video width in pixels, or -1 on error

name: getVideoHeight
description: Returns the native height of the video in pixels. Returns -1 if the video has not been fully loaded.
returnDescription: Video height in pixels, or -1 on error
example:
var height = StelVideoMgr.getVideoHeight("intro");
core.debug("Video height: " + height);

name: muteVideo
description: Mutes or unmutes the audio track of the video.

parameters.name: mute
parameters.description: true to mute, false to unmute

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. Only effective if audio is enabled.

name: setVideoVolume
description: Sets the audio volume level of the video. Values outside 0-100 are clamped.

compatibility.notes: Requires Qt Multimedia module. Only effective if audio is enabled.

name: getVideoVolume
description: Returns the current audio volume level of the video (0-100). Returns -1 if the video is not found or audio is disabled.
example:
var volume = StelVideoMgr.getVideoVolume("intro");
core.debug("Current volume: " + volume + "%");

name: isVideoPlaying
description: Returns whether a video is currently playing.
returnDescription: true if video is playing, false if paused, stopped, or not loaded
